pins.title: Textured Acrylic Painting Process | Coastal Art in Progress
pins.description:
A quiet moment from my painting process 🎨
Working with textured acrylics, layered colors, and expressive brushstrokes inspired by coastal life and the sea.
I love showing the raw, imperfect stages of a painting — where movement, texture, and emotion slowly come together on canvas

If you paint with acrylics, I swear by a continuous water mister and a wet paint palette. It’s the closest I’ll get to achieving that “oil painting” look without actually using oil paints. Plus it saves a TON of money by keeping your paint wet.

pins.title: Artist: @scottlaurenson
pins.description: @scottlaurenson transforms massive canvases into breathtaking seascapes, capturing the power of the ocean, the beauty of lighthouses, & dramatic skies with an incredibly creative painting technique. From using his own hand to softly blend light across the sky to flicking the paintbrush bristles for realistic ocean spray, every method adds depth, movement, & personality, making the entire creative process just as captivating as the finished masterpiece.
